rows.law: one-shot sufficiency is a quality bar, not a convenience
rows.claim: ONE_SHOT_GAME hard-codes the verified six-move anatomy as a contract so one ask ships a playable game with no second prompt needed.
rows.quote: Build a complete, playable game in ONE self-contained {{HTML_FILE | LUAU_MODULE}}. No assets, no network, no build step. A stranger must be playing in 10 seconds.
rows.steal: Give every one-shot workflow ask the stranger-in-10-seconds bar plus fixed answer sections; land it in the ask templates recorded in memory/workflows/REGISTRY.jsonl.
rows.falsifier: A one-shot ask whose output still needs a build step or a follow-up prompt before it is playable.

rows.law: the ask carries its own gate: violating any line voids the answer
rows.claim: Output contracts live inside the prompt text as named fixed sections with a void clause, so enforcement needs no post-hoc checker to exist first.
rows.quote: violating any line voids the answer
rows.steal: Prepend a CONTRACT block (fixed sections: Files / Falsifiers / Kill Round) to specialist-seat asks and queue/handoff briefs so answers are parseable and void-able on drift.
rows.falsifier: A prompt whose answer sections drift or whose contract violations are accepted without voiding the answer.

rows.law: a mechanic without a number is an opinion
rows.claim: DETAIL forces every system claim to carry a number and confines truth to a closed FACTS block with inline CLAIMED marks, so the model cannot invent stats.
rows.quote: A mechanic without a number is an opinion.
rows.steal: Require each gala/steal row to carry a byte-verified quote or a number, else it does not file; land as the standing rule in watch/inbox record laws.
rows.falsifier: A filed design claim with neither number nor quote passing review.

rows.law: the source is the truth; translate, never redesign
rows.claim: PORT_GAME bans inventing source mechanics and demands quoted constants with line references, making fidelity a prompt clause instead of a hope.
rows.quote: Never invent a source mechanic. If the source lacks it, the port lacks it.
rows.steal: When porting any fleet artifact (MUD, games, prompts), copy constants verbatim and list a Kept Verbatim section; land in the next roblox/src port pass.
rows.falsifier: A port whose numbers differ from source with no recorded deviation row.

rows.law: never fabricate liveness; ship the honest fallback inside the prompt
rows.claim: NPC_HEAD pairs a frozen identity prefix with a named degraded mode (firstLine + a recording tag) so dark lanes degrade honestly instead of faking a live model.
rows.quote: Never fabricate a live model. The recording IS the honesty.
rows.steal: Every lane fallback (offline janitor, dark remote seat) ships a named degraded mode in its own prompt, never canned text posing as live; land in mag lane fallback prompts and lab UI status lines.
rows.falsifier: Any surface that presents canned output as live model output.
